message.content: 獅子（屬於貓科，Felidae）與斑馬（屬於馬科，Equidae）雖然同屬哺乳綱（Mammalia），但它們在進化樹上相距甚遠。最接近的共同祖先是「有胎盤哺乳動物」的祖先，約在1億年前的白堊紀末期出現。從那時起，貓形目（Carnivora）和奇蹄目（Perissodactyla）分化開來，後者演化成馬科、斑馬等，而前者則演化成貓科、獅子等。簡言之，獅子和斑馬的共同祖先是早期的有胎盤哺乳動物，距今約1億年左右。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "獅子和斑馬的共同祖先是什麼？" (What is the common ancestor of lions and zebras?). They want an answer. There's no tool needed. Just answer. Probably mention that lions and zebras share a common ancestor in the family Felidae? Actually lions are felids, zebras are equids. They diverged from a common ancestor in the order Carnivora? Wait, lions are mammals, specifically in the order Carnivora, suborder Feliformia. Zebras are mammals, order Perissodactyla. Their common ancestor would be a mammal from the common ancestor of all placental mammals. So the answer: the last common ancestor of lions and zebras is the common ancestor of all placental mammals, which lived about 100 million years ago. Or more specifically, the last common ancestor of the families Felidae and Equidae is the ancestor of the order Carnivora and Perissodactyla, which diverged around 70-80 million years ago. So answer accordingly.
